name: Bio Landhaus Seethaler
beschreibung: The Bio Landhaus Seethaler in Thiersee is a hotel focused on organic farming and sustainable tourism. The rooms are furnished with natural materials and offer views of the surrounding mountains. Guests can enjoy regional organic products at breakfast. The location by Thiersee is ideal for activities such as hiking, cycling, and swimming. In winter, the nearby ski areas are easily accessible. The property also features a wellness area with sauna.
